headline: GRIND CITY opens — one park, long lines, 21-second perfect run
lede: Slot b shipped rung 1 of #3106: GRIND CITY, an own-IP skate park where physics and pixels ride the same analytic surface. The autopilot's proven line scores 18,910 in 21 seconds; the clock gives you two minutes. Slot a shipped MARBLE RUSH the same morning — two original 3D titles in four hours.

notes.text: Skate park done without a single licensed name: drop-in, trench gap, halfpipe coping, boardslide rail, S-K-A-T-E letters — and every number is provable: grindcheck pins rules, winnability on five seeds, and both mutants die.

Two registry laws cost two CI rounds and will save the next lane both: a new aliased check must join the checks.mjs scope table (#1575), and every game dir must file a strict-shape exposeFeedbackState(() => ({...})) report (#1473). Run ciscope --selftest + feedbackcheck before pushing a new game.
The park mesh and the physics share one height function (park.js) — the board can never sink into or float over what you can see. Any new 3D title should copy that pattern, not another game's look.
